name: Raspberry Pretzel “Salad”
subtitle: Introduced by Chloe
notes: A favorite for celebratory meals. Always requested by Mark.

items: 1 cup very cold water or water and ice cubes

steps.title: Make the crust
steps.body: For the bottom “crust,” mix together **3 cups tiny pretzel twists**, crushed, **¼ sugar** and **8 Tbsp melted butter**, and press into a 10×12 pan.

steps.title: Bake the crust
steps.body: Bake 10 minutes at 350°F, then set aside to cool.

steps.title: Beat the cream cheese
steps.body: In a large bowl, with an electric mixer, beat together for about 5 minutes: **16 ounces cream cheese**, softened, **1 cup sugar** and **1 tsp vanilla**.

steps.title: Fold in the topping
steps.body: Fold in **8 ounces frozen whipped topping**, thawed.

steps.title: Spread the cream layer
steps.body: Spread cream mixture over the cooled crust, all the way to the edges, then cover and refrigerate.

steps.title: Cool the layers
steps.body: Let the first two layers cool for an hour.

steps.title: Make the raspberry layer
steps.body: Whisk together until jello is dissolved: **6 ounces raspberry jello** and **1 cup boiling water**.

steps.title: Add the cold water
steps.body: Stir in **1 cup very cold water** or water and ice cubes, and **16 ounces frozen raspberries**.

steps.title: Chill until firm
steps.body: Spoon onto the cream cheese filling and spread to form an even layer, then refrigerate until firm (4–6 hours) before serving.
